The Dracaena Corn Plant (Dracaena fragrans) is a timeless houseplant with thick, woody canes and clusters of long green leaves resembling tropical palms. Known as a symbol of good luck, positivity, and resilience, this plant makes a wonderful gift for housewarmings, new jobs, or wellness occasions. Its upright form and easy-care nature make it a favorite for brightening up living rooms, hallways, or office spaces.

Care Instructions:

Light: Prefers bright, indirect light but tolerates medium to low light.

Water: Water when the top 1–2 inches of soil are dry; do not let sit in soggy soil.

Humidity: Adapts well to average household humidity.

Placement: Great for corners, hallways, and offices where vertical greenery is desired.

The Monstera Deliciosa, also known as the Swiss Cheese Plant, is one of the most iconic and stylish houseplants, loved for its dramatic split and perforated leaves. Native to tropical rainforests, this plant symbolizes long life, growth, and abundance—making it a thoughtful gift for housewarmings, birthdays, and new beginnings. Its bold, architectural look adds instant style to any living room, office, or workspace.

Care Instructions:

Light: Prefers bright, indirect light; tolerates medium light. Avoid harsh direct sun.

Water: Water when the top 2 inches of soil feel dry; do not let roots sit in water.

Humidity: Thrives in moderate to high humidity; mist occasionally.

Placement: Best in spacious rooms where its large leaves can shine. Can be trained to climb with support.

The Rattlesnake Calathea (Calathea Lancifolia) is a unique tropical houseplant with long, wavy leaves patterned in bold green spots and deep purple undersides. Known as a symbol of new beginnings and positivity, this plant makes a thoughtful gift for housewarmings, birthdays, or “just because” occasions. Unlike many houseplants, Calathea is non-toxic to pets, making it an ideal choice for animal lovers.

Care Instructions:

Light: Prefers bright, indirect light but tolerates lower light. Avoid direct sun, which can scorch leaves.

Water: Keep soil consistently moist but not soggy. Water when the top inch begins to dry.

Humidity: Loves high humidity; mist often or place near a humidifier.

Placement: Perfect for living rooms, bedrooms, or offices with filtered light.

Item Name: Small Monstera Deliciosa – Swiss Cheese Plant (6")
Description:
The Small Monstera Deliciosa (also called Swiss Cheese Plant) is a young version of the popular tropical favorite, featuring lush green, heart-shaped leaves. As it matures, its leaves will naturally develop the signature fenestrations (splits and holes). A symbol of growth, vitality, and abundance, this plant makes a thoughtful gift for housewarmings, new jobs, or “just because” occasions. Its manageable size makes it ideal for apartments, desktops, and shelves while still offering the bold greenery Monstera is known for.

Care Instructions:

Light: Prefers bright, indirect light; tolerates medium light.

Water: Water when the top 1–2 inches of soil feel dry. Avoid overwatering.

Humidity: Thrives in moderate to high humidity; mist occasionally.

Placement: Perfect for desks, bookshelves, and small rooms; grows larger with time and repotting.

The ZZ Plant (Zamioculcas zamiifolia) is a resilient, stylish houseplant with upright stems and shiny, dark green leaves. Known as a symbol of prosperity, endurance, and growth, this plant is perfect for busy plant lovers, frequent travelers, or office spaces with low light. It is one of the most forgiving indoor plants, tolerating low light, irregular watering, and a variety of conditions. Its sleek look adds modern charm to any setting.

Care Instructions:

Light: Tolerates low light but thrives in medium to bright indirect light.

Water: Water every 2–3 weeks; allow soil to dry completely between waterings.

Humidity: Adaptable to all household humidity levels.

Placement: Great for desks, shelves, or low-light corners; thrives even with minimal care.
